ava: Morning vote — rainy Saturday soundtrack recs + a short book (<=200 pages) pairing? Looking for moody indie/folk vibes. quick replies please :seedling:

riley: Sufjan Stevens — Carrie & Lowell + "The Sense of an Ending" (Julian Barnes). quiet and bittersweet. :heart:

noah: Phoebe Bridgers — Stranger in the Alps + "The Ocean at the End of the Lane" (Neil Gaiman). ghosty and compact. :ghost:

priya: Big Thief — Capacity + "Dept. of Speculation" (Jenny Offill). fragmented but cozy. :sparkles:

ava: nice, keep 'em coming. maybe something more upbeat for afternoon rain? :coffee:

riley: Fleet Foxes — Helplessness Blues for afternoon energy. pair with "The Art of Racing in the Rain" for weird vibes? (short-ish)

noah: also suggest Waxahatchee — Saint Cloud + "My Year of Rest and Relaxation" (maybe borderline length but reads fast).

priya: vote: morning = Sufjan, afternoon = Fleet Foxes. reactions only :thumbsup: :thumbsdown: :100:

ava: tally so far: :thumbsup: on Sufjan (riley), :100: on Fleet Foxes (riley again). anyone got a mellow instrumental rec?

noah: Boards of Canada — Music Has the Right to Children. pair with a short essay collection, like "The World Without Us" excerpt? (not a novel but hits the mood)

priya: dev-bot can you spin a quick playlist from these picks? :pray:

dev-bot: Created temporary playlist "rainy-indie-pairs" with 20 tracks. Link: https://play.example/playlist/abc123 (expires in 7 days)

ava: perfect — thanks! also, riley, pass me that Barnes short story you mentioned earlier?

riley: dropping in DM now.

noah: last rec — Angel Olsen "All Mirrors" for late-night reflection + "Klara and the Sun" (short but dense).

ava: awesome. wrap-up: Sufjan / Barnes for morning, Fleet Foxes for afternoon, Boards of Canada for instrumentals, and a dev-bot playlist to test. Meet at 3pm in kitchen for tea + headphone swap? :tea:
